svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 960 commits across five public projects, 69 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-25 through 2026-11-16 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-16T16:56:59.057Z.
